$comment: Per-dialect capability descriptor. Read after the http-mcp `transports` tool flags MQTT as adapter-provided.

maps_to.subscribe: CHANNEL (bidi_command) — a long-lived connection to the broker; messages arrive as channel frames
maps_to.publish: CALL (http_request semantics) — fire one message into a topic

why_not_wire: Topic routing and QoS are application-level delivery logic, not a transport shape. The adapter holds the broker connection and exposes CHANNEL frames; the wire never learns about topics.
shape_proven_by: mqtt_test.go — subscribe=CHANNEL, publish=CALL over real MQTT 3.1.1 framing; own both ends (broker+client), stdlib. QoS1/2, retain, will remain the adapter's job.
